text: わての　ポケモン　コレクション　みに　きたの　ちゃうんか？

structure.jp: わての　ポケモン　コレクション
みに　きたの　ちゃうんか？

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb stem with に before 'come' or 'go' says what you come or go to do. みに　きた = 'came to see'.

patterns.name: 〜のではないか
patterns.span: きたの　ちゃうんか
patterns.explanation: の　ちゃうんか is the Kansai dialect form of のではないのか, which asks 'isn't it that...?' when you expected it to be so. きたの　ちゃうんか = 'didn't you come?'
